title: Data Analyst
text: Data Analyst at ANZ (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Ensure timely delivery of data and analytics insights to stakeholders Working across Risk, Legal, Compliance & Operations in gathering and verifying data Join an organisation that supports diversity and equal opportunity employment About The Role Role Location: 242 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000 Role Type: Secondment until November 2^nd, 2018 As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for gathering, organising, and assessing data generated from research or collected from various business and product systems and present findings in a way that allows stakeholders to make informed decisions about regulatory and business events. Moreover, you will support the Governance Manager in relation to regulatory responses. About You To be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following: Proven experience in conducting data analysis activities and abilities in mathematics Understanding of or exposure to statistical methods, data warehousing, data mining, data sampling, and data mapping techniques Ability to present findings in reports and conduct intensive research Strong communication skills and proven problem-solving skills About ANZ At ANZ, everything we do boils down to ‘why’ – our purpose – to shape a world where people and communities thrive. We're just as focused on seeing our people thrive as well as our customers. We'll give you every opportunity to develop your career. We are responding faster to changing customer requirements, focusing on the things that matter the most, energising our people, eliminating waste and reducing bureaucracy. A happy workplace is a thriving one. So in order to attract and keep the best talent, and say thanks for the hard work, we make sure all our employees are rewarded. To find out more about working at ANZ or to view other opportunities visit www.anz.com/careers. You may apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and search for reference number AUS083078. #GD5.1
